clue.text: The artist returned permitted dope index

indicators.note: returned tells us to turn the two words for permitted and dope round together

parts.note: permitted means let, as in allowed
dope can mean a fool or sap
an index is a list of entries

explanation.surface: A painter has come back to a list of allowed drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns LET + SAP into PASTEL as a single run.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastellist is a painter who works in pastel crayons.

clue.text: Ifa young creature admits a number, blow up!

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the young creature takes a letter inside

parts.note: a pup is a young dog or seal
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a number

explanation.surface: An excited exclamation about a puppy taking in a figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ifa' is the newspaper's run-together 'If a'. M (a thousand) goes inside PUP.
explanation.definitionFit: To pump a tyre or balloon is to inflate it.

clue.text: Wearing a T-shirt, or the only one in a suit?

definitions.text: the only one in a suit

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest, a kind of T-shirt
if you have something on you are wearing it

explanation.surface: Dressed casually, or the lone card of its suit in a bridge hand?
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a singlet' is what 'wearing a T-shirt' says, so SINGLET is followed by ON.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games a singleton is a lone card held in a suit.

clue.text: A flier may have some regrets

indicators.note: some means only part of the following word supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A bird may be carrying a few regrets.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a heron-like bird, so a flier.

clue.text: Tenants to watch in inferior accommodation

indicators.note: accommodation means housing, so one word is housed inside the other

parts.note: less means inferior or lower in rank
to see is to watch

explanation.surface: Renters keep an eye on their substandard lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodation' is the container signal: inferior lodgings take in the watching.
explanation.definitionFit: Lessees hold property on a lease, so they are renters.

clue.text: Set right about a place in Washington

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the phrase for set right goes round the letter

parts.note: to settle a dispute is to set it right

explanation.surface: Correcting something concerning a location in the US capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Washington' suggests the capital DC; it is the state, home of Seattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Seattle is the largest city in Washington state.

clue.text: A heroic tale presented in black-and-white pictures

indicators.note: presented in means the letters are shown inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A grand story of heroes shown in old monochrome films.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across the end of 'black-and-white' and the start of 'pictures'.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrative of heroic deeds is the classic sense of the word.

clue.text: Social occasion for a group of politicians

definitions.meaning: a gathering with drinks and dancing
a political organisation such as Labour or the Conservatives

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a festive gathering and an organised political body.

clue.text: The stockman browbeat the boxer

parts.note: to cow someone is to browbeat or intimidate them
a boxer is a puncher

explanation.surface: A rancher bullied a prize fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowpuncher is a cowboy who herds cattle, a stockman.

clue.text: Liking both to write and sing music

parts.note: to pen a letter is to write it
to chant is to sing, especially plainsong

explanation.surface: Fondness for composing as well as performing songs.
explanation.definitionFit: A penchant is a strong taste or fondness for something.

clue.text: The 'manual worker down-under

parts.note: a labourer who works beneath the ground rather than in Australia, as down-under suggests

explanation.surface: An Australian labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down-under' suggests Australia; here it means below ground. The stray apostrophe is a print slip.
explanation.definitionFit: A labourer digging coal underground is the classic manual worker below the surface.

clue.text: A shabby fellow bearing with tribulation and triumph

parts.note: S, south, is a compass bearing
care means worry or trouble
to crow is to boast in triumph

explanation.surface: A down-at-heel man carrying his troubles and victories.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragged, unkempt person is called a scarecrow, after the figure in a field.

clue.text: The home check-up can be most boring

parts.note: a flat is a home, an apartment
a test is a check-up

explanation.surface: Testing yourself at home can be very dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat means dull or lifeless, so the superlative means dullest.

clue.text: Little beast retiring-with back-up

parts.note: coy means shy or retiring

indicators.note: back tells us to read the following word in the other direction

explanation.surface: A small animal that is shy but has support.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu is a South American rodent, a small creature.

clue.text: Inspired head including a craft no-one backed up

indicators.note: including means containing, so the word for head wraps the rest

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
SS, steamship, is a craft

indicators.note: backed up in a down clue means the letters run upwards, so reversed

parts.note: no gives NO and one gives I

explanation.surface: An inspired leader with a boat that nobody supported.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed up' reverses no-one in this down clue; 'including' sends A, the ship and that reversal inside the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspired here means fervent or full of feeling.

clue.text: Account long hair essential for a woman in the theatre

parts.note: a tress is a long lock of hair

explanation.surface: Long hair being vital for a stage performer's account.
explanation.definitionFit: An actress is a female performer on stage.

clue.text: About half-a dozen get notice maybe, and removal's arranged

indicators.note: arranged means put in a new order, so the letters are shuffled

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral six, half a dozen

explanation.surface: Roughly six people receive a notice and their removal is organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' shuffles VI and NOTICE; 'About' and 'get' are surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Eviction is the forced removal of tenants from a property.

clue.text: From Castile originally, so tolerant

indicators.note: originally signals the letters of the place name being made into something new

explanation.surface: Someone from a Spanish region is said to be easy-going.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic means flexible or accommodating, hence tolerant.

clue.text: A player who finds his performance no laughing matter

definitions.text: A player who finds his performance no laughing matter

parts.words: A player who finds his performance no laughing matter
parts.note: an actor whose roles are serious and sorrowful rather than comic

explanation.definitionFit: A tragedian is an actor who specialises in tragic roles.

clue.text: Falling in behind the head of state, the top man

indicators.note: behind means the preceding piece comes after the letter from state
head of means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: a king is the top man of a realm

explanation.surface: A ruler stumbles behind the leader of the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinking means falling or going down.

clue.text: Hard stuff in great variety

indicators.note: variety suggests a different form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Strong stuff comes in many great kinds.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a very hard igneous rock.

clue.text: Distracted caterer getting run over

indicators.note: distracted means confused, so the letters of the next word are jumbled

explanation.surface: A flustered caterer gets hit by a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrace steps is to go back over them again.

clue.text: Overdue, being in the red, it's reported

indicators.note: in places the word for overdue inside the colour

parts.note: red is the colour itself
late means overdue

explanation.surface: Being late with payments and overdrawn has been talked about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the red' looks like overdrawn, but 'in' simply puts overdue inside the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Related means told or recounted, as a story is.

clue.text: Zero should appear here

definitions.meaning: an old variant for nought, nothing

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an old form of nought and also a verb meaning have an obligation to.

clue.text: Midnight, with nothing on hand

parts.note: the middle of the word night is its middle letter, G
love is zero in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: At twelve at night, with nothing in your hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Midnight' is read as mid-night: the centre letter of the word night.
explanation.definitionFit: A glove is worn on the hand.

clue.text: Everybody turned to Edward, as intended

parts.note: all means everybody

indicators.note: turned means the small word is flipped round

parts.note: Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Everyone switched to Edward, as planned.
explanation.definitionFit: Allotted means assigned or destined, as something intended for one.

clue.text: A jerk will hold on to get a drink

indicators.note: will hold means the word for jerk goes round the small word

parts.note: a tic is a spasmodic jerk

explanation.surface: An idiot clings on to obtain a beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonic water is a mixer drink.

clue.text: Scraps the difference

definitions.meaning: the margin between two quantities, as in what is the gap

explanation.definitionFit: The word means leftover bits and also the amount by which things differ.

clue.text: A game American fighter-a good man-a champion

parts.note: polo is a game on horseback
GI is a US soldier
ST, saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: A sporting US soldier, a decent chap, a champion.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologist defends or champions a cause.

clue.text: Nymph in a tizzy, given a little publicity

indicators.note: tizzy means agitated, so the small words are scrambled

parts.note: an ad is a small advertisement

explanation.surface: A water spirit is flustered by a bit of exposure.
explanation.definitionFit: A naiad is a water nymph in Greek myth.

clue.text: Quits when flush

definitions.meaning: having settled, owing nothing either way

explanation.definitionFit: The word means square after a debt and also level with something.

clue.text: One can't interrupt repairs for the poor beggars!

indicators.note: interrupt means break into, so the pieces go inside the word for repairs

parts.note: mends means repairs
I is the Roman numeral one
the word as written, without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: A single person is unable to stop repairs for the needy.
explanation.definitionFit: Mendicants are beggars, often religious ones living on alms.
